t: An open-source robot hand with four fingers you can print and build.
steps: Buy a kit from Seeed Studio or WowRobo for about 99 US dollars, or gather parts from the open parts list.
Print the parts yourself if you skip the kit.
Assemble the fingers and palm with the build guide on GitHub.
Connect the servos to a serial bus servo board and a 5 volt, 2 amp power supply.
Install Python on your computer and download the AmazingHand code.
Run the calibration script to set each finger's middle position.
Run the demo script and watch the fingers move.
Try the webcam hand tracking demo next.
meta: Wild Open. From $99. A few stores.
